summary: Master e-signatures, PKI, and digital record integrity with our 5-day expert-led course. Ensure legal admissibility and ISO compliance. Enroll today.
lede: Digital record authentication and e-signature training covers ways to verify electronic transactions and preserve the reliability of digital evidence. Designed for records managers, information-governance staff, security auditors, and legal professionals, it develops practical skills in risk-based authentication, signature and hash verification, metadata and audit-trail management, chain-of-custody documentation, and long-term digital preservation.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the lifecycle of digital evidence and the security of electronic transactions.
modules: Foundations of Digital Trust and ISO 15489
Legal Admissibility and Chain of Custody
Securing Records in Cloud and Mobile Ecosystems
AI, Deepfakes, and Emerging Integrity Threats
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of information management or IT security principles. Familiarity with basic document management systems (DMS) and a general awareness of organizational compliance requirements is recommended. No advanced programming knowledge is required, though comfort with technical interfaces and data structures will be beneficial for the cryptographic exercises.
